messages:
kevin: heads up — deploybot just auto-paused the orbit-service rollout (v2.3.1). canary error rate spiked to ~12% (503s) :rotating_light:

deploybot: [SYSTEM] Release hold: orbit-service@2.3.1. Trigger: canary error rate > 10% for 5m. Remaining phases paused.

maria: ugh. any logs or quick hints on root cause yet?

oncall-sre-bot: gathering canary logs and /var/log/kvcache. early signal: eviction/latency spike correlated with recent kernel tuning.

oliver: if kernel tweak is suspicious we should not roll forward. proposal: pin traffic back to v2.3.0 on warm nodes and cancel remaining canary phases.

trina: agree. plan: pin to 2.3.0, abort pending canary retries, schedule backfill for low-traffic window. mark release as paused in release notes.

kevin: executing pin + pause now. commands:

```
# pin warm pools to previous image
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/orbit-service orbit=registry/redwood/orbit:2.3.0 --record
kubectl -n prod rollout pause deployment/orbit-service
```

kevin: done — warm pools pinned, rollout paused. :white_check_mark:

deploybot: [SYSTEM] Action recorded: manual image pin to orbit:2.3.0 by kevin. Rollout state: paused.

maria: please abort canary jobs so they don't keep retrying and hitting affected hosts.

kevin: aborted scheduled canary jobs and removed auto-retry hooks.

oncall-sre-bot: pushed affected host logs to #eng-sre. initial read: OOM-kill entries around same timestamp as eviction spikes.

oliver: can SRE revert the kernel tweak on the affected node-pool and cordon hosts until we get a green soak? minimizes blast radius.

trina: Ops, prep backfill/resume window: 2026-03-22 03:00 UTC - 05:00 UTC. Owners: oliver (SRE), trina (releases), kevin (deploy).

oncall-sre-bot: cordon + kernel rollback scheduled; will update here when complete.

kevin: updated release board: v2.3.1 -> paused due to kvcache regression. Linked incident INC-2026-1123 in the changelog.

maria: short action list added to release ticket:
- SRE confirm kernel rollback and run 1h soak
- run regression tests for 2.3.1 in sandbox post-fix
- update release notes: paused + regression details
- trigger post-mortem if we need a patch release

kevin: pinned release metadata in Console to prevent accidental promote.

deploybot: [SYSTEM] Hold remains active. Automated resume blocked until manual clear by release owner.

oliver: cordon + rollback finished. nodes re-provisioning, initial health checks look ok. starting 60m soak now.

trina: after soak, we'll either re-run canary with 2.3.1 or keep 2.3.0 and roll a patched build.

kevin: noted. I'll not clear the hold until we see regression test pass.

maria: sending schedule update to stakeholders and product.

kevin: closing thread for now — will reopen if we requeue the rollout or change the plan.

trina: reminder to restore automated retries only after explicit manual clear.

deploybot: [SYSTEM] Thread note saved: manual hold by kevin.
